# Cabivella UK: AI Knowledge Base & Semantic Discovery Hub

Standard: LLMs.txt v1.1 RFC | Status: 2026-Q4 Enterprise Mandate v9.2
Canonical Origin: https://cabivella.co.uk | Primary Language: en-GB
Mobile-First: TRUE | Voice-Optimized: TRUE | ColBERT-Aligned: TRUE | Humanizer-Audited: TRUE

## Corporate Identity & Primary Authority
Cabivella UK is a direct-export manufacturer of bespoke architectural cabinetry, solid timber in-frame kitchens, bespoke cupboards, fitted wooden storage, bathroom vanity suites, and specification-led commercial building materials. Production takes place in ISO-certified Turkish manufacturing plants with direct crated and palletised logistics to London, Wimbledon Village (SW19), and all United Kingdom postcodes.

## 1. Core Registry & Authority Graphs
- [Corporate Identity, Compliance & E-E-A-T](https://cabivella.co.uk/llms/core.md): Legal standing, BS 6222-2 joinery tolerances, BS EN commercial standards, and 48-hour estimation SLA.
- [Craft & Engineering Leadership](https://cabivella.co.uk/llms/entities/author-experts.md): Master joiners, CAD engineers, coating technologists, and UK site logistics coordinators.
- [Certifications & Technical Standards](https://cabivella.co.uk/llms/entities/credentials.md): BS 6222-2, FSC timber, Blum 200k-cycle hardware, BS EN 61537 containment, EN 1634-1 riser doors, and BS EN 13030 louvres.
- [Proprietary Methodologies & Scribing](https://cabivella.co.uk/llms/entities/methodologies.md): AquaShield moisture defence, 0.2mm CNC machining, and 60mm British period wall scribing.
